raw_goal: Build a runnable local browser task board app, not a media processing app. Use index.html, CSS, and JavaScript with localStorage. Include add/edit/delete task workflows, Todo/Doing/Done columns, seed data, and a real package.json test script that can run locally.

interpreted_needs.need: A local-first media workflow that turns raw files into traceable review/export artifacts.
interpreted_needs.customer_problem: The customer likely needs repeatable processing and review, not just a video player or static demo.
interpreted_needs.target_user: Editors, operators, or solo creators managing local media material.
interpreted_needs.evidence_from_goal: Build a runnable local browser task board app, not a media processing app. Use index.html, CSS, and JavaScript with localStorage. Include add/edit/delete task workflows, Todo/Doing/Done columns, seed data, and a real package.json test script that can run locally.
assumptions: Local operation matters unless the customer explicitly asks for cloud processing.
